opening.argument: The video presents a Lowe's promotion offering gift cards, with the title stating “Free Gift Cards From Lowe's up to $500” and the speaker identifying it as “a promotion from Lowe's.” Viewers are told to text SPRING, receive a link, and click through to a coupon, with no purchase required. The promotion also includes stated limits: one household per day and one coupon per person, with coupons not combinable. Although the speaker discusses releasing a phone number and creating another account with a fake email to repeat the attempt, those unusual instructions do not by themselves establish a scam mechanism. The central subject remains an advertised retail coupon or gift-card campaign and its stated conditions.
